The Mergers and Acquisitions team oversees AES's growth through mergers, divestitures, partnerships, restructurings, and acquisitions by assessing and executing potential transactions in conjunction with local business leaders in AES markets. In addition to driving traditional growth for AES, such transactions are also helping AES to deliver innovations that transform customer experience and operations for the electric sector as whole. The M&A team serves as a center of excellence within AES for the technical and professional skills required in such transactions.
The M&A Senior Associate will lead analysis of M&A transactions and manage such transactions as appropriate. The position is also responsible for other quantitative and qualitative analysis, at the direction of management.

Responsibilities:

• Lead several work streams for live transactions, including development of the financial model, creation of the confidential information memorandum (for divestitures/partnerships), coordination of the Q&A process, management of external consultants, and negotiation of parts of the transaction documentation
• Design, build, and use financial and valuation models, including DCF and earnings models, to assess individual projects and AES as a whole
• Analyze potential transactions and investments under the direction of transaction leaders, including strategic and financial impacts and risks
• Manage an associate or other junior team member on internal projects, as requested by management
• Coordinate the gathering, validation, synthesis and interpretation of data from confidential and public sources to assist in analysis
• Develop a deep understanding of AES corporate and business structure, financials, valuation, credit ratings, strategy, capital costs, and tax position for use in transaction assessments
• Attain a working understanding of AES markets, their drivers, and ways to capture and drive industry innovation through mergers and acquisitions
• Prepare and deliver presentations and reports to communicate findings and recommendations
• Interact with other AES groups and AES businesses in a professional manner to collect information and documents, validate analyses, and facilitate internal and external due diligence
• Coordinate interaction with external parties and advisors
• Support internal processes for transaction assessment/approval, including Investment Committee memos and presentations

Skills and Qualifications:

• Bachelor s Degree in an analytical discipline
• MBA or other relevant Master s Degree highly preferred
• 5+ years of work experience
• Demonstrated analytical experience and intellectual curiosity
• Strong interpersonal skills, including ability to communicate complex matters in a convincing manner to diverse stakeholders
• Strong Excel financial modeling skills and proficient in Microsoft Word and PowerPoint
• Detailed understanding of financial statement mechanics and business valuation theory
• Proficient in use of financial research tools, such as Bloomberg, Capital IQ and Thomson One

The Senior Project Engineer on the Mega and M&A Engineering team will be responsible for design and engineering of utility scale solar PV and energy storage projects in development and construction phases. Responsibilities include lead and support engineering activities across the full project lifecycle, including design development and peer reviews, energy and performance modeling, equipment selection and specifications, and preparation of engineering calculations. Provide technical inputs to support Engineer Procure Construct (EPC) pricing estimates, RFP responses, permitting applications, design drafting, and technical due diligence for M&A project evaluations. Responsibilities also include engineering management, development and review of contract documents, participation in technical negotiations, preparation of procurement specifications, punch list development, and delivery of ongoing technical support throughout project execution.

Designs will be developed, optimized, analyzed, and reviewed using industry-standard tools, including PVsyst, AutoCAD, Civil 3D, GIS, MS Office, and SharePoint. This role will provide technical leadership across multiple projects by defining design-phase roadmaps, establishing development engineering standards and processes, and training and mentoring junior engineers. The successful candidate will manage complex, multi-project priorities, communicate progress to the Senior Manager of Mega and M&A Engineering, and operate effectively with distributed and remote teams. A strong background in the development, execution, analysis, and design of utility-scale, transmission-interconnected PV and battery energy storage systems is required, along with a demonstrated ability and commitment to coaching and developing engineering talent. Experience with additional renewable technologies such as wind, green hydrogen, or hydroelectric systems is a plus. Excellent communication, planning, and task-management skills, combined with broad technical expertise, are essential for success in this role.

The position is in Louisville, CO / Houston, TX / Salt Lake City, UT / or New York, NY and may include up to 25% travel to project locations and partner offices, including international travel.

Key Responsibilities

Project Development
M&A
- Perform full technical due diligence and risk assessment for the M&A projects
- Full project design evaluation to identify red flags and fatal flows
- Redesign and update layouts, energy production estimates, EPC cost estimates, and equipment selections
- Coordinate with M&A developer to complete necessary RFP response documentation
- Design for select projects up to 30% electrical, civil, structural, and mechanical

Project Execution
Mega
- Develop scopes of work and technical contract exhibits.
- Seek and evaluate proposals for engineering services.
- Manage engineering consultants and EPC contractors to develop project construction drawings and support materials.
- Perform technical project due diligence and project engineering design reviews.
- Coordinate feedback from internal stakeholders and subject matter experts (SMEs) on design reviews.
- Value engineer PV and BESS system designs to maximize reliability and reduce overall project cost.
- Establish/review technical specifications of owner furnished equipment in coordination with Procurement and Sourcing.
- Technical support during construction including:
- Respond to contractor requests for information (RFIs).
- Perform quality assurance (QA)/ quality control (QC) checks in the field.
- Develop punchlists.
- Support commissioning activities with internal Technology/Commissioning teams and external stakeholders.
- Review commissioning reports and analyze system performance.
- Support internal Owner’s Engineering team through financing activities.
- Support Operations/Asset Management teams to resolve technical issues at operating sites.
- Assist Development and Project Management teams with budget development and key financial inputs.
- Develop and implement technical solutions to region/market specific requirements in coordination with Director of Engineering, Mega Projects.

Growth and Leadership
- Contribute to process improvement initiatives for the development and execution of safe, quality, and high-performance projects.
- Develop inter-engineering processes for sharing information and best practices among the team
- Manage relationships with 3rd party engineering consultants and firms utilized by the team
- Mentor and train the team on changing trends in technology, best practices, and safety
- Participate in AES Clean Energy’s growth planning process by contributing to process improvement task forces and other strategic planning activities

Skills and Qualifications

Primary Qualifications
- Undergraduate degree in Engineering or equivalent technical field
- 5+ years of professional experience in solar PV system design, development, construction, and analysis preferred
- Proficiency in PV system design, including 1-line and 3-line diagram conventions, NEC design requirements, overcurrent protection sizing, utility disconnecting means requirements, equipment selection, grounding methodologies, and short circuit current analysis
- Experience with medium voltage collector system design
- Effective leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills
- Ability to work in a team environment
- Proficient with MS Office Suite

“Plus” Qualifications
- Graduate degree in Engineering
- PE license
- PMP Certification
- NABCEP PV Installation Professional certification
- 2-5 years of experience with Battery Energy Storage Systems design and modeling
- Experience with MATLAB, ETAP, SKM, and other advanced modeling tools
- Substation/HV design experience
- NFPA 70E, OSHA 10-hr or comparable job-site safety certification

As a Senior FP&A Data Analyst , you will play a key role in helping our Corporate FP&A team transform complex financial and operational data into actionable business insights. Working at the intersection of finance, data analytics, and business strategy, you will help identify the key drivers behind financial performance and forecasts across a global energy business.

This is an exciting opportunity to work with large datasets, advanced analytics, AI-enabled tools, and Power BI solutions to support strategic decision-making. You will collaborate with colleagues across finance, operations, commercial teams, and senior leadership while contributing to the growth and transformation of a dynamic organization in the global power sector.

Core Competencies
- Ability to collaborate effectively across functions, teams, and geographic regions.

- Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.

- Curiosity and a continuous improvement mindset.

- Excellent organizational and time management skills.

- Attention to detail while maintaining focus on broader business objectives.

- Ability to prioritize and adapt in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

- Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to influence and build relationships across teams.

- Ability to work independently while knowing when to seek guidance or collaborate with others.

Key Responsibilities
- Maintain and enhance Power BI models, dashboards, and reporting solutions used to analyze business performance and explain financial variances.

- Design and develop new Power BI reporting solutions for a variety of stakeholders, including finance, operations, commercial teams, and executive leadership.

- Become a subject matter expert in budgeting and forecasting systems, supporting data integrity and processes that enable accurate financial planning across a growing multi-billion-dollar business.

- Partner with FP&A colleagues to identify process improvement opportunities and implement data-driven solutions that increase efficiency and insight generation.

- Collaborate with internal stakeholders to strengthen data quality, governance, and stewardship practices.

- Support recurring and ad hoc analysis, reporting requests, and business performance reviews.

- Leverage analytics, automation, and emerging technologies to improve financial reporting and decision-making processes.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience developing and maintaining Power BI data models, dashboards, and reporting solutions.

- Experience working with planning and forecasting platforms such as BPC, Anaplan, Oracle, SAP, or similar tools.

- Understanding of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) and financial statement analysis, including forecasting and performance analysis.

- Advanced Excel modeling and analytical capabilities.

- Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present insights to both technical and non-technical audiences.

- Proficiency in English.

- Experience working with large datasets, business intelligence tools, AI-enabled analytics, or data automation solutions is a plus.

Education
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Management Information Systems, Data Analytics, Business, Economics, or a related field.

AES Clean Energy is seeking a Senior Analyst to join our FP&A and Transaction s team, responsible for the  financial management  of a portfolio of renewable energy assets.

The Senior Analyst will own the financial reporting cycle end-to-end for an assigned portfolio of assets, serve as a key point of contact for internal stakeholders, and collaborate with project finance, execution, and treasury to drive financial performance and transparency. This is a high-visibility role with frequent engagement with senior leadership.

Financial Planning & Analysis

- Lead monthly EBITDA and cash forecasting, annual budget development, and long-range financial planning for assigned assets

- Identify  financial risks and opportunities; partner with project finance and execution to surface and quantify key drivers

- Prepare and  maintain  financial models supporting portfolio performance tracking and scenario analysis

- Ensure all variances exceeding materiality thresholds are accompanied by complete driver narrative including one-time vs. recurring characterization and forward-looking outlook

- Prepare and respond to ad hoc financial inquiries from external and internal partners, ensuring accuracy and professional presentation

- Support strategic initiatives as required

- Assist with portfolio-level initiatives and cross-functional workstreams across finance, legal, treasury, and development

- Investor-quality communication:  Ability to translate complex financial data into clear, precise narratives for external audiences

- Analytical rigor:  Comfortable working across large datasets and multiple models under tight deadlines with high accuracy

- Stakeholder influence :  Effective at building alignment across teams and without direct authority

- Proactive ownership:  Takes initiative on deliverables,  anticipates  stakeholder needs, and escalates risks through the right channels

- Composure under pressure:  Demonstrates sound judgment and steady execution in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment

QUALIFICATIONS

- 3+ years of experience in FP&A, project finance, or a related financial analysis role

- Strong financial modeling skills in Excel; experience with SAP, BPC, Anaplan, or comparable planning tools

- Solid grounding in GAAP across the income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow statement

- Experience in the energy, infrastructure, or real assets sector preferred

- Familiarity with project finance structures, joint ventures, or bond/lender reporting a strong plus

- Fluent in English (required)

- Bachelor’s degree in Finance , Accounting, or a related field

Principal Duties and Responsibilities :

The FP&A Associate will provide wholistic financial management of  a portfolio of ~ 1GW of t hermal and Utility scale r enewable power plants in operations.

- Wholistic financial management includes monthly performance review, monthly forecasting of EBITDA and earnings, annual budgeting, identifying financial risk and opportunities, working with asset management and operations leaders to optimize financial performance

- Support lender and tax equity relationship and reporting

Core Competencies :

Candidates need excellent problem solving, communication and interpersonal skills, along with patience, a positive attitude, and the ability to work in a demanding team environment.  They should also possess the following competencies :

- Ability to coordinate different projects cross functional. Influence without direct authority

- Good communicator, able to tell business driver stories from the numbers

- Good analytical and time management skills

- Bring s trong attention to detail and ability to zoom out and see the big picture

- Proven ability to produce high quality work a nd meet deadlines

-   Has experience moving multiple projects forward and juggling competing priorities

Qualifications

- 5 + years’ experience in preparing and coordinating budgets, forecasts, and related reporting.

- Strong understanding of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) including experience with financial reporting, forecasting and analysis across the income statement, balance sheet and statement of cash flows.

- Ability to work effectively with accounting systems , SAP , BPC, Anaplan or similar

- Experience building 3 statement financial models from scratch .

- Has experience with financial oversight fo r renewable power plant s or  thermal power plant . Coal power plant experience is a plus

- Fluent in English (required); proficiency in Spanish is a plus

Education :

- Bachelor’s degree in finance or accounting , or a relevant field

If you're ready to be part of a company that's not just adapting to change, but driving it, AES is the place for you. We're not just building a more sustainable future ,  we're powering it. Apply now and energize your career with a true leader in global energy.

The Associate (Regional), Growth Strategy advances AES US Renewables & Power growth West Regional markets (CAISO, non-CA WECC) by identifying high-value opportunities, leading project diligence, and translating market signals into actionable recommendations. This role owns complex projects and assigned strategic initiatives that support regional Market Strategy and Action Plans to strengthen the development pipeline.

The Associate supports the development and execution of project origination approaches aligned with regional priorities across solar, storage, and powered land, including complex and infrastructure-constrained opportunities. Working with regional Development teams and Interconnection, Transmission Strategy, Land Acquisition, Policy/Regulatory, and Commercial partners, the Associate defines diligence plans, coordinates stakeholders, resolves key uncertainties, and develops go/no-go recommendations. The role also leads analyses supporting regional market intelligence, M&A targeting, and evaluation of inbound opportunities.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical judgment with initiative and project ownership. They anticipate challenges, navigate ambiguity, and build expertise in assigned markets to connect policy, infrastructure, and commercial insights to practical development decisions.

Key Responsibilities
Support development and execution of project origination strategies that create competitive advantage and identify new growth opportunities.
Own site-level evaluation of greenfield opportunities across land, transmission access, interconnection, permitting, offtake potential, and market fit; lead cross-functional diligence and develop go/no-go recommendations.
Analyze U.S. power markets, policy developments, and interconnection trends to prioritize opportunities and assess implications for project siting, economics, and development timelines.
Develop market growth plans that translate research into clear priorities, origination approaches, and execution plans.
Prepare regulatory briefs, impact assessments, and position recommendations to support engagement with market operators, regulators, and industry working groups.
Apply GIS tools to evaluate and communicate project opportunities, transmission infrastructure, interconnection queues, pipelines, and market trends.
Present strategic insights and recommendations to leadership, clearly communicating assumptions, tradeoffs, risks, and proposed actions.
Lead initiatives that improve pipeline quality, M&A targeting, and forward origination; develop repeatable tools and processes that strengthen decision-making.
Build subject matter expertise in assigned markets or strategic topics and serve as a resource for cross-functional partners.
Identify and frame emerging strategic questions, conducting targeted analyses to support leadership decisions.
Qualifications
Strong market intuition and ability to turn complex inputs (queue, policy, IX data) into clear strategic insights.
Track record of owning high-impact deliverables with minimal supervision.
Excellent cross-functional communication skills, including experience working with M&A, Policy, or Interconnection teams.
Ability to lead initiatives that span tools, analysis, and stakeholder coordination.
Education
Bachelor’s degree in business, Economics, Engineering, Public Policy, Environmental Science, or a related field required.
Advanced degree (MBA, MPA, MS) preferred
Work Experience
4–8 years of experience in development, commercial, strategy, consulting, market research, investment banking, or a related analytical role.
Experience in clean energy, infrastructure, or regulated industries required.
Skills
Advanced Excel and PowerPoint proficiency; strong modeling and storytelling skills.
Proficient in GIS tools (e.g., QGIS, ArcGIS, Google Earth).
Experience with queue data, interconnection mapping, or policy overlays a strong plus.
Familiarity with visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) and cloud-based datasets preferred.
Licenses and Certifications
None required; certifications in GIS, data analytics, energy policy, strategy, or financial modeling are a plus.
Training
Role-specific onboarding provided. Strategic exposure and development opportunities aligned with career goals.
Physical Demands
Primarily desk-based work with standard computer use; Occasional travel for offsite meetings or conferences.
Working Environment
A fast-paced, team-oriented environment focused on innovation and business growth.
Collaborative and cross-functional, with high exposure to senior leadership and strategic initiatives.

Senior Procurement Specialist, Renewable Energy

Make an Impact in the Future of Clean Energy
Are you passionate about renewable energy, strategic procurement, and driving large-scale infrastructure projects? Join our growing team and play a key role in delivering utility-scale solar projects across the United States.
As a Senior Procurement Specialist, Renewable Energy , you will collaborate with cross-functional teams and industry-leading suppliers to ensure the successful procurement and delivery of critical solar equipment. This role offers the opportunity to influence project success, contribute to clean energy growth, and expand your expertise in solar technology, supply chain strategy, regulatory compliance, and stakeholder management.

What You'll Do
In this role, you will:
- Build and strengthen strategic relationships with key renewable energy supply chain partners, with a focus on photovoltaic (PV) modules and racking systems.
- Optimize equipment allocation across project portfolios by balancing project requirements, inventory availability, and contractual commitments.
- Coordinate the execution of equipment purchasing agreements to support project development and delivery.
- Manage purchase orders for PV modules and racking systems, ensuring timely delivery, milestone tracking, and payment coordination.
- Partner with Engineering, Project Management, Legal, Finance, and other stakeholders to incorporate critical project requirements into procurement strategies.
- Support compliance with Safe Harbor provisions, Domestic Content requirements, FEOC regulations, and evolving industry standards.
- Validate supplier documentation and maintain accurate procurement records.
- Manage procurement requests throughout the procure-to-pay process.
- Support financial planning activities, including payment tracking and cash flow forecasting.
- Coordinate responses to lender, investor, EPC, and third-party due diligence requests.
- Manage warranty claims through commercial operation and provide procurement support to operations teams when needed.
- Serve as a trusted escalation point for procurement execution challenges and drive resolution across stakeholders.
- Lead and improve tracking, auditing, and data management processes related to equipment procurement and allocation.
- Represent company values through collaboration, integrity, and a commitment to operational excellence.
- Travel occasionally (approximately two times per year) for team meetings, workshops, or business needs.

What Will Help You Succeed
We are looking for someone who enjoys solving complex challenges, building strong partnerships, and supporting high-impact renewable energy projects.
Key strengths include:
- Strong organizational, analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
- Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects in a dynamic environment.
- A proactive mindset with a focus on continuous improvement and accountability.
- Confidence working independently while also collaborating effectively across diverse teams.
- Attention to detail combined with a strategic perspective.

Preferred Qualifications
We recognize that talent comes from many backgrounds. If your experience differs from the qualifications below but you believe you can excel in this role, we encourage you to apply.
- Experience supporting procurement, supply chain, project execution, renewable energy, or related industries.
- Knowledge of utility-scale renewable energy projects, solar technologies, or large infrastructure projects.
- Strong analytical and relationship-building skills with the ability to communicate effectively across technical and business audiences.
- Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and familiarity with Power BI, AI-enabled tools, or data analytics platforms.
- Experience using SAP or similar ERP systems.
- Education, certifications, or equivalent professional experience in engineering, supply chain management, business operations, or related disciplines.

Why Join Us?
- Be part of the transition to a more sustainable energy future.
- Work on large-scale renewable energy projects with meaningful business and environmental impact.
- Collaborate with experienced professionals across procurement, engineering, finance, legal, and project delivery teams.
- Gain exposure to advanced procurement strategies, regulatory developments, and emerging solar technologies.
- Expand your leadership and stakeholder management capabilities through high-visibility projects.
- Participate in a collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture where diverse perspectives are welcomed and respected.
- Access opportunities for continuous learning, professional development, and career growth.

Position summary
The Lead Analyst, Business Transformation leads the day-to-day delivery of adoption consulting work for initiative owners across US Renewables & Power, supporting the adoption and long-term sustainment of cross-functional initiatives. Working under the direction of the Director, Business Transformation, this role sets the practical direction for how adoption work gets executed and serves as the senior hands-on expert on the team.
The role engages with leadership across Commercial, Development, Execution, Finance, Operations, and Digital, and partners closely with HR, the HRBPs, and the US R&P CM team to align Business Transformation work with their change management efforts.

Key responsibilities
- Adoption consulting delivery: Lead the execution of the Business Transformation (“BT”) Adoption approach across US R&P, guiding how the team applies communications, training, knowledge, document, and orchestration consulting to support initiative owners.
- Methodology and frameworks: Apply, refine, and help evolve the methodology, toolkits, playbooks, and standards that initiative owners use to design and execute adoption plans.
- Long-term ownership framework: Help define and operationalize the model for identifying long-term owners of adoption tracking, sustainment measurement, and maintenance, so adoption doesn't stop when projects close.
- Leadership engagement: Engage with leadership to identify upcoming initiatives, align on the BT Adoption approach, and report on how the team is supporting business outcomes.
- HR and CM partnership: Work with HR, the HRBPs, and the US R&P CM team to align BT Adoption's work with their change management efforts.
- Cross-functional BT coordination: Coordinate with BT S2G, BT Training, and BT Knowledge and Documentation teams to help ensure the four teams deliver a coherent transformation model end-to-end.
- Reporting: Synthesize adoption insights and outcomes for leadership and help represent BT Adoption in BT and US R&P forums.
- Team guidance: Mentor and guide fellow analysts on adoption tactical execution work, setting the standard for quality.

Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Organizational Development, Information Science, Communications, or equivalent study/work experience.
- 3-5 years of experience in business transformation, change management, program management, or a related discipline, with demonstrated growth in scope and responsibility.
- Experience contributing to and helping shape methodologies, frameworks, toolkits, or playbooks for cross-functional work.
- Experience serving as a lead or senior resource on projects, coordinating the work of others and mentoring less-experienced analysts (formal direct-report management not required).
- Ability to engage, advise, and influence senior stakeholders, with experience presenting on approach, progress, and risk.
- Strong strategic thinking, problem-solving, and analytical skills, with the ability to work across business functions.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with comfort facilitating cross-functional conversations, including at the leadership level.
- Excellent facilitation skills, with experience leading workshops, stakeholder sessions, and planning efforts.

Preferred attributes
- Familiarity with adoption measurement.
- Certifications in Lean Six Sigma, Agile, PMP, CKM, or related disciplines.
- Knowledge of the energy industry and renewable generation technologies.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office 365, including Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams, OneNote, and SharePoint.
